claims.text: The exaggeration rate in Figure 3a is calculated based on the comparison of claims made in press releases versus those in associated research papers, focusing on cases where press releases used stronger claims than the original research.
The trend of exaggeration rate shown in Figure 3a indicates a significant decreasing trend since 2010, supported by a Spearman rank correlation coefficient of -0.88.
